movers.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) was limited Thursday after missing Wednesday; status for Sunday at Detroit TBD. Rookie Jalon Daniels took first-team reps Wednesday.
QB Kyler Murray (grade 2 hamstring) is out; the Vikings target a Nov. 29 return. Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.
QB Geno Smith (ankle) was limited again Thursday and is questionable; he says he plans to play at the Chargers. Rookie Cade Klubnik would start if he can't.
OL: OT Asim Richards (knee) out multiple weeks; OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) did not practice Thursday and are doubtful at Chicago.
CB Marlon Humphrey will not play Sunday vs. Carolina (coach's decision) after podcast comments about Baltimore, per Jesse Minter. DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) DNP Thursday.

TB.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) was limited Thursday after missing Wednesday; status for Sunday at Detroit TBD. Rookie Jalon Daniels took first-team reps Wednesday.
S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) did not practice Wednesday and is questionable.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (grade 2 hamstring) is out; the Vikings target a Nov. 29 return. Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.
WR Jordan Addison had thumb surgery and is out; the Vikings will not place him on IR, per Kevin O'Connell.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited Thursday and WR Jauan Jennings (calf) full Wednesday after missing time.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (ankle) was limited again Thursday and is questionable; he says he plans to play at the Chargers. Rookie Cade Klubnik would start if he can't.

ARI.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow, IR) had season-ending UCL surgery. Starter Carson Beck (back) was limited Thursday and is questionable for Sunday at Kansas City.

NO.text: OL: OT Asim Richards (knee) out multiple weeks; OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) did not practice Thursday and are doubtful at Chicago.

DET.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) on IR, out for the season. C Cade Mays (ankle) not expected to play Sunday vs. Tampa Bay, per the Detroit Free Press. CB D.J. Reed (hip) limited.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland and G Tyler Booker (both high-ankle sprains) are out vs. Tennessee; S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) remains on IR.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), out 7 games, practiced fully Thursday after being designated to return from IR.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16, per ESPN's Dan Graziano. Jacoby Brissett starts vs. Carolina.
CB Marlon Humphrey will not play Sunday vs. Carolina (coach's decision) after podcast comments about Baltimore, per Jesse Minter. DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) DNP Thursday.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) on IR; surgery still being evaluated. Kyle McCord remains the starter.

PHI.text: Nick Sirianni named Joe Milton the starter vs. the Steelers for a second straight game; Tanner McKee is the backup. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out 3 games, practiced fully Thursday. LB Zack Baun (back) did not practice Wednesday.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin) did not practice Thursday; S Amani Hooker (knee) limited. Both questionable at Miami.

KC.text: RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) did not practice Thursday. G Trey Smith (concussion) and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) missed Wednesday's practice, per the Chiefs' official site.

CIN.text: G Dalton Risner (knees) did not practice Thursday; G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) is also questionable for Monday at Washington.

JAX.text: C Robert Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday vs. the Giants, per Liam Coen. DE Travon Walker (ribs) and WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle) limited.

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) was limited Thursday after sitting out Wednesday; Klint Kubiak said he doesn't need to practice to play Sunday vs. Denver.

PIT.text: G Mason McCormick (dislocated ankle) placed on IR Wednesday.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR), out 5 games, practiced again Thursday after being designated to return.

TEN.text: WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) placed on IR and is out for the season, per Robert Saleh.
WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), out 2 games, was limited again Thursday and is questionable vs. Dallas.

DEN.text: S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), out since Week 5, practiced fully; CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle) full Thursday. S Brandon Jones (hamstring) limited.
